source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现write_objects(io,rows)。先完整校验rows中name为非空不含NUL的唯一str、body为bytes，非法ValueError且不能部分写入；随后对每个原name直接io.write_full(name,body)。不得按路径取basename、规范化斜杠、切namespace或写本地文件。不改输入或已有保护对象。真实RADOS中a/item与b/item不同对象，../outside和UTF8键也是不透明对象名，二进制原样回读。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Ceph16.2.15私有MON/内存型OSD/RADOS读写，pool中的对象键不是POSIX路径。实验关闭Cephx，仅本容器隔离网络；不验证生产账号权限、磁盘耐久、物理文件布局或生产容灾。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

"""Experimental nonroot, private MON/memstore OSD; no question or incident credit."""
import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados
assert os.geteuid()==1000
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/opt/opsforge-ceph')
ENV={**os.environ,'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 result=subprocess.run([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout
def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-private-ceph-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
fsid = {fsid}
mon initial members = a
mon host = 127.0.0.1:{port}
auth cluster required = none
auth service required = none
auth client required = none
public addr = 127.0.0.1
cluster addr = 127.0.0.1
ms bind ipv4 = true
ms bind ipv6 = false
ms async op threads = 1
log to stderr = true
log to file = false
run dir = {root}/run
crash dir = {root}/crash
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
admin socket = {root}/$name.asok
pid file = {root}/$name.pid
keyring = {root}/$name.keyring
mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true
osd pool default size = 1
osd pool default min size = 1
osd pool default pg num = 1
osd pool default pgp num = 1
osd pool default pg autoscale mode = off
osd crush chooseleaf type = 0
rados mon op timeout = 3
rados osd op timeout = 3
[mon.a]
mon data = {root}/mon.a
mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}
[osd]
osd objectstore = memstore
osd data = {root}/osd.$id
keyring = {root}/osd.$id/keyring
osd memory target = 134217728
memstore device bytes = 134217728
osd op num shards = 1
osd op num threads per shard = 1
osd op num shards hdd = 1
osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1
osd op num shards ssd = 1
osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     assert status['monmap']['fsid']==self.fsid;break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MEMSTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()

for executable in ('ceph-mon','ceph-osd'):
 assert 'ceph version 16.2.15 ' in command(executable,'--version')

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,rados
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from ceph_cluster_native import PrivateCeph
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def all_objects(io):return {obj.key:io.read(obj.key) for obj in io.list_objects()}
def omap(io,name):
 with rados.ReadOpCtx() as op:
  values,unused=io.get_omap_vals(op,'','',100);io.operate_read_op(op,name);return dict(values)
with PrivateCeph() as cluster:
 cluster.add_osd();cluster.client.create_pool('owned_objects')
 with cluster.client.open_ioctx('owned_objects') as io:
  io.write_full('protected',b'keep-existing')
  rows=[{'name':'a/item','body':b'a-binary\x00\xff'},{'name':'b/item','body':b'different-b'},{'name':'../outside','body':b'opaque-not-a-filesystem-path'},{'name':'目录/事件','body':b'utf8-key'}];before=copy.deepcopy(rows)
  print('NATIVE_CEPH_REAL_POOL_IO_READY_KEYS_ARE_OPAQUE_NOT_DIRECTORY_HIERARCHY',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:write_actual_rados_literal_slash_dotdot_utf8_keys_without_basename_collision',flush=True)
  try:task.write_objects(io,rows)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual RADOS object-key write failed') from error
  expected={'protected':b'keep-existing',**{row['name']:row['body'] for row in rows}}
  assert all_objects(io)==expected,'object key treated as filesystem path or basename instead of opaque RADOS identity'
  for invalid in ([{'name':'bad\x00key','body':b'x'}],[{'name':'','body':b'x'}],[rows[0],rows[0]],[{'name':'bad-type','body':'text'}]):
   try:task.write_objects(io,invalid)
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('invalid/ambiguous keys accepted')
   assert all_objects(io)==expected
  assert rows==before
  print('NATIVE_RADOS_SLASH_KEYS_SAME_BASENAME_DISTINCT_DOTDOT_OPAQUE_UTF8_BINARY_PROTECTED_OBJECT_RETAINED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实OMAP与对象数据分离：单WriteOp补改元数据键，保留body和xattr
answer:
```python
import rados
def patch_omap(io,name,updates,removed):
    if set(updates)&set(removed):raise ValueError('update/remove scopes overlap')
    if any(not isinstance(key,str) or not key or '\x00' in key for key in [*updates,*removed]) or any(not isinstance(value,bytes) for value in updates.values()):raise ValueError('literal OMAP keys and binary values required')
    with rados.WriteOpCtx() as op:
        io.remove_omap_keys(op,list(removed))
        io.set_omap(op,list(updates),list(updates.values()))
        io.operate_write_op(op,name)
```

原题知识说明：
OMAP 是 Ceph RADOS 对象附带的有序键值映射，用于保存某些应用元数据。它不同于普通对象内容和扩展属性，过大的 OMAP 可能影响性能与维护。应使用对应产品工具诊断，不能把清空 OMAP 当通用修复。

body:
## 操作任务
实现patch_omap(io,name,updates,removed)。两集合不能相交，所有键为非空不含NUL str、更新值bytes，否则ValueError且零提交。用rados.WriteOpCtx在同一对象单次操作中remove_omap_keys、set_omap并operate_write_op一次；保留其他OMAP键、对象body、xattr及其他对象，不改输入。真实二进制OMAP值含NUL/FF，删除不存在键可安全完成，禁止把OMAP JSON覆盖对象body或clear_omap清空保护键。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Ceph16.2.15单MON/内存型OSD上的实际OMAP WriteOp、binary值、body/xattr独立访问；不把内存型实验声称BlueStore性能、RBD或RGW large-OMAP治理，也不证明跨对象事务。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

  io.write_full('protected',b'other-object')
  with rados.WriteOpCtx() as op:io.set_omap(op,['keep','updated','delete'],[b'keep-binary\x00\xff',b'old',b'drop']);io.operate_write_op(op,name)
  updates={'updated':b'new-binary\x00\xff','added':b'added'};removed=['delete','absent'];before=copy.deepcopy((updates,removed));commits=[]
  class Counted:
   def __getattr__(self,key):return getattr(io,key)
   def operate_write_op(self,op,obj):commits.append(obj);return io.operate_write_op(op,obj)
  print('NATIVE_CEPH_OBJECT_DATA_XATTR_AND_OMAP_DISTINCT_REAL_BINARY_STATES_READY',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:single_object_writeop_patch_omap_keep_body_xattr_other_keys_other_objects',flush=True)
  try:task.patch_omap(Counted(),name,updates,removed)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual OMAP metadata patch failed') from error
  expected={'keep':b'keep-binary\x00\xff',**updates}
  assert omap(io,name)==expected and io.read(name)==body and io.get_xattr(name,'owner')==b'keep-xattr' and io.read('protected')==b'other-object','OMAP keys, body, xattr or unrelated object corrupted'
  assert commits==[name] and (updates,removed)==before
  try:task.patch_omap(Counted(),name,{'overlap':b'x'},['overlap'])
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('overlapping metadata scope accepted')
  assert commits==[name] and omap(io,name)==expected
  print('NATIVE_OMAP_ONE_REAL_ATOMIC_WRITEOP_BINARY_VALUES_BODY_XATTR_KEEP_KEY_OTHER_OBJECT_UNCHANGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

"""Experimental nonroot, private MON/memstore OSD; no question or incident credit."""
import json,os,pathlib,socket,subprocess,tempfile,time,uuid
import rados
assert os.geteuid()==1000
TOOL=pathlib.Path('/opt/opsforge-ceph')
ENV={**os.environ,'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph')+':'+str(TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu')+':'+str(TOOL/'lib/x86_64-linux-gnu'),'PYTHONPATH':str(TOOL/'usr/lib/python3/dist-packages')}
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):
 result=subprocess.run([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' private command failed: '+result.stdout[-1000:]+result.stderr[-3000:])
 return result.stdout
def port():
 with socket.socket() as endpoint:endpoint.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));return endpoint.getsockname()[1]
class PrivateCeph:
 def __enter__(self):
  self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-private-ceph-');self.root=pathlib.Path(self.temp.name);self.processes=[];self.logs=[];self.client=None
  try:
   self.fsid=str(uuid.uuid4());self.monport=port();self.config=self.root/'ceph.conf';self.monmap=self.root/'monmap';self.mondata=self.root/'mon.a';self.mondata.mkdir()
   (self.root/'run').mkdir();(self.root/'crash').mkdir()
   self.config.write_text('''[global]
fsid = {fsid}
mon initial members = a
mon host = 127.0.0.1:{port}
auth cluster required = none
auth service required = none
auth client required = none
public addr = 127.0.0.1
cluster addr = 127.0.0.1
ms bind ipv4 = true
ms bind ipv6 = false
ms async op threads = 1
log to stderr = true
log to file = false
run dir = {root}/run
crash dir = {root}/crash
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
admin socket = {root}/$name.asok
pid file = {root}/$name.pid
keyring = {root}/$name.keyring
mon data avail crit = 0
mon data avail warn = 0
mon allow pool delete = true
mon allow pool size one = true
osd pool default size = 1
osd pool default min size = 1
osd pool default pg num = 1
osd pool default pgp num = 1
osd pool default pg autoscale mode = off
osd crush chooseleaf type = 0
rados mon op timeout = 3
rados osd op timeout = 3
[mon.a]
mon data = {root}/mon.a
mon addr = 127.0.0.1:{port}
[osd]
osd objectstore = memstore
osd data = {root}/osd.$id
keyring = {root}/osd.$id/keyring
osd memory target = 134217728
memstore device bytes = 134217728
osd op num shards = 1
osd op num threads per shard = 1
osd op num shards hdd = 1
osd op num threads per shard hdd = 1
osd op num shards ssd = 1
osd op num threads per shard ssd = 1
osd recovery max active = 1
osd max backfills = 1
osd class dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/rados-classes
erasure code dir = {tool}/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph/erasure-code
'''.format(fsid=self.fsid,port=self.monport,root=self.root,tool=TOOL))
   command('monmaptool','--create','--fsid',self.fsid,'--add','a','127.0.0.1:'+str(self.monport),self.monmap)
   command('ceph-authtool','--create-keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring','--gen-key','-n','mon.')
   command('ceph-mon','--mkfs','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--monmap',self.monmap,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--keyring',self.root/'mon.keyring')
   monitor=self.start('ceph-mon','-f','-i','a','-c',self.config,'--mon-data',self.mondata,'--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
   deadline=time.monotonic()+20;last=None
   while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    if monitor.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private MON exited before readiness: '+self.log_tail())
    try:
     status=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',self.root/'mon.a.asok','mon_status',timeout=3))
     if status.get('state') not in ('leader','peon'):time.sleep(.2);continue
     assert status['monmap']['fsid']==self.fsid;break
    except Exception as error:
     last=error
     time.sleep(.2)
   else:raise RuntimeError('private MON readiness failed: '+str(last)+' '+self.log_tail())
   print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MON_READY '+json.dumps({'fsid':self.fsid,'uid':os.geteuid(),'quorum':status.get('quorum'),'network':'none-loopback-only'}),flush=True)
   self.client=rados.Rados(conffile=str(self.config),name='client.admin');self.client.connect(timeout=3)
   return self
  except BaseException:self.__exit__(None,None,None);raise
 def start(self,name,*args):
  log=(self.root/(name+'-'+str(len(self.processes))+'.log')).open('wb');self.logs.append(log)
  process=subprocess.Popen([str(TOOL/'usr/bin'/name),*map(str,args)],env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log);self.processes.append(process)
  return process
 def mon(self,prefix,**kwargs):
  rc,out,err=self.client.mon_command(json.dumps({'prefix':prefix,'format':'json',**kwargs}),b'')
  if rc:raise RuntimeError('private mon command '+prefix+' failed: '+str(rc)+' '+str(err))
  try:return json.loads(out)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:return out.decode().strip()
 def add_osd(self):
  osduuid=str(uuid.uuid4());created=self.mon('osd create',uuid=osduuid);osdid=int(created['osdid'] if isinstance(created,dict) else created);data=self.root/('osd.'+str(osdid));data.mkdir()
  command('ceph-osd','--mkfs','--mkkey','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-uuid',osduuid,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  process=self.start('ceph-osd','-f','-i',osdid,'-c',self.config,'--osd-data',data,'--osd-objectstore','memstore','--setuser','1000','--setgroup','1000')
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('private OSD exited: '+self.log_tail())
   status=self.mon('osd dump');row=next((row for row in status['osds'] if row['osd']==osdid),None)
   if row and row['up']==1 and row['in']==1:break
   time.sleep(.2)
  else:raise RuntimeError('private OSD readiness timeout: '+self.log_tail())
  print('NATIVE_PRIVATE_CEPH_MEMSTORE_OSD_READY '+str(osdid),flush=True);return osdid
 def log_tail(self):
  return '\n'.join(path.read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] for path in self.root.glob('*.log'))
 def __exit__(self,*args):
  if self.client:
   try:self.client.shutdown()
   except Exception:pass
  for process in reversed(self.processes):
   if process.poll() is None:process.terminate()
   try:process.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
  for log in self.logs:log.close()
  self.temp.cleanup()

for executable in ('ceph-mon','ceph-osd'):
 assert 'ceph version 16.2.15 ' in command(executable,'--version')

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,rados
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from ceph_cluster_native import PrivateCeph
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def all_objects(io):return {obj.key:io.read(obj.key) for obj in io.list_objects()}
def omap(io,name):
 with rados.ReadOpCtx() as op:
  values,unused=io.get_omap_vals(op,'','',100);io.operate_read_op(op,name);return dict(values)
with PrivateCeph() as cluster:
 cluster.add_osd();cluster.client.create_pool('owned_health_probe')
 with cluster.client.open_ioctx('owned_health_probe') as io:
  io.write_full('protected',b'existing-data')
  health=cluster.mon('status')['health'];assert health['status']=='HEALTH_WARN' and 'POOL_NO_REDUNDANCY' in health['checks']
  before=copy.deepcopy(health);name='approved-probe';payload=b'known-rados-probe\x00\xff';calls=[]
  class Counted:
   def write_full(self,key,value):calls.append(('write_full',key,value));return io.write_full(key,value)
   def read(self,key):calls.append(('read',key));return io.read(key)
   def remove_object(self,key):calls.append(('remove_object',key));return io.remove_object(key)
  print('NATIVE_CEPH_REAL_HEALTH_WARN_POOL_NO_REDUNDANCY_WHILE_PROTECTED_OBJECT_READS',flush=True)
  assert io.read('protected')==b'existing-data'
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:retain_actual_warning_then_verify_only_approved_probe_write_read_cleanup',flush=True)
  try:result=task.probe(Counted(),health,name,payload)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual warning/IO distinction failed') from error
  assert result=={'health_status':'HEALTH_WARN','probe_io_succeeded':True}
  assert calls==[('write_full',name,payload),('read',name),('remove_object',name)],'availability asserted without actual bounded IO probe'
  assert all_objects(io)=={'protected':b'existing-data'} and health==before
  assert cluster.mon('status')['health']['status']=='HEALTH_WARN','warning was hidden to make probe look healthy'
  print('NATIVE_HEALTH_WARN_PRESERVED_ONE_REAL_RADOS_PROBE_SUCCEEDED_NO_ALL_CLUSTER_AVAILABILITY_CLAIM',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
